style.name: Chinese Paper-cut
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #123: Chinese Paper-cut / 中国剪纸. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes as complete contemporary paper-cut narratives: hand-cut red paper fibers, crisp positive-negative shapes, layered translucent crimson, vermilion, warm white and restrained black accents, fine scissor and knife details, folk window-cut rhythm, symbolic flora, clouds, waves and architectural silhouettes. Each modern news subject must become a different spatial scene rather than a repeated template, generic sphere, three number cards or dashboard. Keep copy on calm low-texture warm-white or pale-red fields with strong contrast; reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 readable modules, with large type, generous line spacing and breathing room. News scenes, evidence and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central paper-cut globe or flowing world-map scene, using sweeping ribbon paths, layered cut-paper foreground and background, organic asymmetry and varied information shapes rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each summary needs a quiet readable field, clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: AI搜索、单人用户研究、AI社交获客、跨境高尔夫、住房贫困、洪灾物流、海洋雷达与乳腺癌风险进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月18日全球经营雷达；AI搜索、单人用户研究、AI社交获客、跨境高尔夫、住房贫困、洪灾物流、海洋雷达与乳腺癌风险进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. Google更新AI Mode与AI Overviews，增加更靠前的行内链接、官方站点专区、及时文章和可点击创作者资料。
2. ValidateThat由Ryan Byrne一人打造，用真实用户完成创意验证与用户研究，TrustMRR验证MRR 613美元、19个活跃订阅。
3. Sensorhub.ai用AI监测Reddit、LinkedIn与X的高意向对话并辅助销售触达，验证MRR 966美元、近30天收入985美元。
4. Function18接入本地货币、支付、税费与多语言结账后，两年内全球跨境销售同比增长超过130%。
5. 联合国称2026年约8.26亿人生活在极端贫困中，超过28亿人面临某种住房不适足问题。
6. 尼泊尔洪水冲毁道路后，联合国协调返程直升机运出约8000公斤蔬菜，但仍有多达700吨收成等待外运。
7. 1940至2025年再分析显示，海洋增暖正强化中低纬大气波导，改变海上雷达、通信与导航传播。
8. WHO欧洲区称14国仅15%的受访者知道酒精可导致乳腺癌，并上线基于WHO证据的AI筛查助手。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是把搜索、收入、物流与公共风险都落到可核验的结果上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先分清已经发生的结果、仍待解决的限制，再决定下一步。

en-US.headlineView: AI search, solo user research, AI social selling, cross-border golf, housing poverty, flood logistics, ocean radar and breast-cancer risk enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 18 Global Operator Radar; AI search, solo user research, AI social selling, cross-border golf, housing poverty, flood logistics, ocean radar and breast-cancer risk enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Google updated AI Mode and AI Overviews with more prominent inline links, an official-site section, timely articles and clickable creator profiles.
2. Ryan Byrne built ValidateThat alone to validate ideas and run user research with real participants, while TrustMRR verifies $613 MRR and 19 active subscriptions.
3. Sensorhub.ai uses AI to monitor high-intent conversations across Reddit, LinkedIn and X and support sales outreach, with $966 verified MRR and $985 in last-30-day revenue.
4. Function18 added local currencies, payments, duties and multilingual checkout, then grew global cross-border sales by more than 130% year on year within two years.
5. The UN says about 826 million people live in extreme poverty in 2026 and more than 2.8 billion face some form of inadequate housing.
6. After floods destroyed a road in Nepal, the UN coordinated return-leg helicopter flights that moved about 8,000 kilograms of vegetables, while as much as 700 tons still awaits transport.
7. Reanalysis from 1940 to 2025 shows ocean warming is strengthening atmospheric ducts at mid and low latitudes, changing maritime radar, communication and navigation propagation.
8. WHO Europe says only 15% of respondents across 14 countries knew alcohol can cause breast cancer and launched an AI screening assistant grounded in WHO evidence.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is to ground search, revenue, logistics and public risk in verifiable outcomes.
en-US.doudouQuote: Separate delivered results from unresolved limits before choosing the next move.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Google让AI搜索更直接连接原始网页
zh-CN.headlineView: AI Mode与AI Overviews增加更靠前的行内链接、官方站点专区、及时文章和可点击创作者资料
zh-CN.headlineFull: Google让AI搜索更直接连接原始网页；AI Mode与AI Overviews增加更靠前的行内链接、官方站点专区、及时文章和可点击创作者资料
zh-CN.intro: Google于10月15日宣布更新Search中的AI Mode与AI Overviews，把更多行内链接提前放入生成式回答，让用户在阅读答案时直接打开相关网页；对只有一两个权威入口的任务，系统将测试在顶部突出官方站点并解释用途。新闻与时效内容获得新的视觉轮播和链接，创作者资料也可点击查看背景。Google称这些改动旨在让探索网页更简单、更可追溯，但生成式摘要仍属实验功能。对出版者与品牌而言，机会来自被明确引用和进入官方入口；限制是展示、点击分配、摘要准确性和流量变化仍由平台控制，页面被链接不等于获得稳定访问或转化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI搜索真正的改进，不只是回答更多，而是让用户更容易回到证据与行动入口。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 链接变多是可见性机会，流量和转化仍需单独验证。

en-US.headlineFact: Google makes AI Search connect more directly to original webpages
en-US.headlineView: AI Mode and AI Overviews add more prominent inline links, an official-site section, timely articles and clickable creator profiles
en-US.headlineFull: Google makes AI Search connect more directly to original webpages; AI Mode and AI Overviews add more prominent inline links, an official-site section, timely articles and clickable creator profiles
en-US.intro: Google announced updates to AI Mode and AI Overviews in Search on October 15, placing more inline links higher inside generated answers so people can open relevant webpages while reading. For tasks with only one or two authoritative destinations, Google will test a dedicated section near the top that highlights official sites and explains why each is useful. News and timely content receive new visual carousels and links, while creator profiles become clickable for more context. Google says the changes are meant to make web exploration simpler and more traceable, but generative summaries remain experimental. Publishers and brands gain a chance to be explicitly cited or surfaced as an official destination; the limits are that presentation, click allocation, summary accuracy and traffic shifts remain platform-controlled, and a link does not guarantee durable visits or conversion.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI search improves not only by answering more but by making evidence and action destinations easier to reach.
en-US.doudouQuote: More links create visibility; traffic and conversion still need separate proof.

sources.title: Google Puts Inline Links Higher In More AI Search Responses

zh-CN.headlineView: 把创意验证、卡片分类、树测试和调查交给真实用户，19个活跃订阅支撑19至49美元月费
zh-CN.headlineFull: ValidateThat一人运营，验证MRR 613美元；把创意验证、卡片分类、树测试和调查交给真实用户，19个活跃订阅支撑19至49美元月费
zh-CN.intro: 美国创始人Ryan Byrne一人打造ValidateThat，面向UX团队、独立开发者、教育者和学生，先用真实用户判断商业创意，再运行卡片分类、树测试、原型测试与调查，并通过Prolific招募参与者。TrustMRR以Stripe验证累计收入6975美元、近30天收入907美元、MRR 613美元和19个活跃订阅，数据更新于10月8日。变现包括免费方案、19美元Starter与49美元Pro；获客渠道标注为SEO和Google Ads，交付依靠网页产品、嵌入式研究组件、参与者招募与自动化分析。杠杆是把昂贵研究流程产品化，限制是样本质量、招募成本、19个订阅的集中风险、付费广告效率与B2B销售尚未验证。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人研究工具赚钱，是把专业流程压缩成小团队可以立即购买的结果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 613美元MRR证明有人付费，样本质量与获客成本决定它能否放大。

en-US.headlineView: Idea validation, card sorts, tree tests and surveys run with real users, while 19 active subscriptions support $19-to-$49 monthly pricing
en-US.headlineFull: Solo-run ValidateThat verifies $613 MRR; Idea validation, card sorts, tree tests and surveys run with real users, while 19 active subscriptions support $19-to-$49 monthly pricing
en-US.intro: US founder Ryan Byrne built ValidateThat alone for UX teams, indie hackers, educators and students. Customers can test a business idea with real users, then run card sorts, tree tests, prototype tests and surveys while recruiting participants through Prolific. TrustMRR verifies through Stripe $6,975 in total revenue, $907 in last-30-day revenue, $613 MRR and 19 active subscriptions, updated October 8. Monetization combines a free plan, $19 Starter and $49 Pro. Listed acquisition channels are SEO and Google Ads, while delivery relies on the web product, embeddable research components, participant recruitment and automated analysis. Leverage comes from productizing an expensive research workflow. Limits include sample quality, recruitment cost, concentration across only 19 subscriptions, paid-acquisition efficiency and an unproven B2B sales motion.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A solo research tool earns by compressing a professional workflow into a result small teams can buy immediately.
en-US.doudouQuote: $613 MRR proves payment; sample quality and acquisition cost determine whether it scales.

zh-CN.headlineView: AI监测Reddit、LinkedIn与X的高意向对话，10个活跃订阅支撑59至129美元B2B月费
zh-CN.headlineFull: Sensorhub.ai验证MRR 966美元；AI监测Reddit、LinkedIn与X的高意向对话，10个活跃订阅支撑59至129美元B2B月费
zh-CN.intro: 保加利亚创始人Kalo Yankulov推出Sensorhub.ai，面向营销、SEO/AEO和销售团队，用AI监测Reddit、LinkedIn与X中的相关对话，识别高意向买家，辅助及时参与讨论，并追踪品牌被大模型引用的机会。TrustMRR通过Dodo Payments验证累计收入6792美元、近30天收入985美元、MRR 966美元和10个活跃订阅，最近一期收入较前期增长12%，数据更新于10月16日。基础版59美元/月、Pro版129美元/月，企业版询价；交付依赖网页监测、跨平台数据、AI分类和告警。商业结果说明小批B2B客户愿意为高意向线索付费，限制是客户数很少、平台接口变化、误报、合规边界与客户集中风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI销售工具赚钱，不在于收集更多帖子，而在于更快找到真正准备购买的人。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 966美元MRR来自10个订阅，单客价值可见，集中风险也很高。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: AI monitors high-intent conversations across Reddit, LinkedIn and X, with 10 active subscriptions supporting $59-to-$129 B2B monthly plans
en-US.headlineFull: Sensorhub.ai verifies $966 MRR; AI monitors high-intent conversations across Reddit, LinkedIn and X, with 10 active subscriptions supporting $59-to-$129 B2B monthly plans
en-US.intro: Bulgarian founder Kalo Yankulov built Sensorhub.ai for marketing, SEO/AEO and sales teams. Its AI monitors relevant conversations across Reddit, LinkedIn and X, identifies high-intent buyers, helps teams engage quickly and tracks opportunities to be cited by large language models. TrustMRR verifies through Dodo Payments $6,792 in total revenue, $985 in last-30-day revenue, $966 MRR and 10 active subscriptions, with the latest period up 12%, updated October 16. Basic costs $59 per month, Pro $129 and Enterprise is quoted; delivery depends on web monitoring, cross-platform data, AI classification and alerts. The result shows a small set of B2B customers will pay for high-intent leads. Limits are the tiny customer count, platform API changes, false positives, compliance boundaries and customer concentration.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI sales software earns not by collecting more posts but by finding people ready to buy sooner.
en-US.doudouQuote: $966 MRR from 10 subscriptions reveals value per account and high concentration risk.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Function18全球跨境销售同比增长超过130%
zh-CN.headlineView: 本地货币、150多种支付、税费预付和30多种语言结账，把高尔夫服饰卖向更多非欧盟市场
zh-CN.headlineFull: Function18全球跨境销售同比增长超过130%；本地货币、150多种支付、税费预付和30多种语言结账，把高尔夫服饰卖向更多非欧盟市场
zh-CN.intro: 英国专业高尔夫服饰零售商Function18面对国际竞争、VAT与关税、昂贵运费、退货和风险管理成本，原有跨境运营难以继续增长。接入Global-e后，商店提供100多种本地货币、150多种支付方式、税费计算与预付、30多种语言欢迎信息和结账，并把履约、法规与风险管理的一部分交给服务商。案例显示上线两个月国际销售同比增长超过30%，欧盟以外市场增长超过50%，两年后全球跨境销售同比增长超过130%；2017年国际销售增长超过90%，回头客比例增长80%。赚钱机制是高尔夫垂类需求与本地化转化，数据来自服务商客户案例，净利润仍受商品毛利、物流、退货、税费、服务费和市场年份差异影响。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境垂类店的增长杠杆，是把本地结账与复杂履约从成本中心变成转化工具。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 130%是销售增长，不是净利润；时间背景和服务成本必须一起看。

en-US.headlineFact: Function18 grew global cross-border sales by more than 130% year on year
en-US.headlineView: Local currencies, 150-plus payment methods, prepaid duties and checkout in 30-plus languages carried golf apparel into more non-EU markets
en-US.headlineFull: Function18 grew global cross-border sales by more than 130% year on year; Local currencies, 150-plus payment methods, prepaid duties and checkout in 30-plus languages carried golf apparel into more non-EU markets
en-US.intro: UK specialist golf apparel retailer Function18 faced international competition plus rising VAT, duty, shipping, returns and risk-management cost, making its existing cross-border operation difficult to scale. After adding Global-e, the store supported more than 100 currencies, 150-plus payment methods, duty and tax calculation with prepayment, localized welcome messages and checkout in over 30 languages, while outsourcing part of fulfilment, legal and risk work. The case study reports international sales grew more than 30% year on year within two months, non-EU locations rose over 50% and global cross-border sales exceeded 130% year-on-year growth two years later. In 2017, international sales rose more than 90% and returning international customers increased 80%. The earning mechanism combines specialist golf demand with localization. The numbers come from a vendor-customer case, and net profit still depends on product margin, logistics, returns, duties, service fees and the historical period.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A niche cross-border store grows when local checkout and complex fulfilment become conversion tools instead of pure cost centers.
en-US.doudouQuote: The 130% figure is sales growth, not net profit; timing and service cost still matter.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 2026消除贫困日把安全住房置于核心
zh-CN.headlineView: 约8.26亿人仍生活在极端贫困中，超过28亿人面临某种住房不适足问题
zh-CN.headlineFull: 2026消除贫困日把安全住房置于核心；约8.26亿人仍生活在极端贫困中，超过28亿人面临某种住房不适足问题
zh-CN.intro: 联合国把2026至2028年国际消除贫困日主题定为“团结促进和平与人权”，2026年聚焦“人人享有安全住房”。联合国估计，2026年约8.26亿人、即全球人口10%，仍以2021年购买力平价每日不足3美元生活；超过28亿人面临不安全、负担不起、拥挤或不稳定等住房不适足问题，38亿人没有任何社会保护。行动要求把适足住房作为人权与预算优先项，让经历贫困与住房排斥的人直接参与政策设计，并动员公共融资扩大安全、可负担住房。数据是全球估计而非单一国家普查，目标落地仍取决于土地、建设成本、租赁治理、公共服务和持续融资。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 住房不是贫困政策的附属项，而是健康、教育、工作和尊严的共同底座。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 全球估计揭示规模，真正改善要落到可负担、稳定和有基本服务的家。

en-US.headlineFact: The 2026 Poverty Day puts safe housing at the center
en-US.headlineView: About 826 million people still live in extreme poverty and more than 2.8 billion face some form of inadequate housing
en-US.headlineFull: The 2026 Poverty Day puts safe housing at the center; About 826 million people still live in extreme poverty and more than 2.8 billion face some form of inadequate housing
en-US.intro: The UN set the 2026-2028 International Day for the Eradication of Poverty theme as “United for Peace and Human Rights,” with the 2026 focus “Safe Homes for All.” The UN estimates about 826 million people, 10% of the world, live below $3 a day in 2021 purchasing-power parity in 2026. More than 2.8 billion face unsafe, unaffordable, overcrowded or insecure housing, while 3.8 billion lack any social-protection coverage. The call is to treat adequate housing as a human-rights and budget priority, involve people experiencing poverty and housing exclusion directly in policy design and mobilize public finance for safe, affordable homes. These are global estimates rather than a single-country census; implementation still depends on land, construction cost, rental governance, basic services and sustained financing.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Housing is not an appendix to poverty policy but the shared foundation of health, education, work and dignity.
en-US.doudouQuote: Global estimates show the scale; improvement means affordable, stable homes with basic services.

sources.title: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 尼泊尔让救援直升机返程运出8000公斤收成
zh-CN.headlineView: 洪水冲毁唯一道路后，联合国把空返运力变成蔬菜市场通道，但仍有多达700吨等待外运
zh-CN.headlineFull: 尼泊尔让救援直升机返程运出8000公斤收成；洪水冲毁唯一道路后，联合国把空返运力变成蔬菜市场通道，但仍有多达700吨等待外运
zh-CN.intro: 8月26日Bhotekoshi洪水冲毁尼泊尔Rasuwa的桥梁和道路后，Aamachhodingmo四个地区约8000万尼泊尔卢比的卷心菜和土豆与市场断开。一条发到联合国尼泊尔Facebook页面的求助信息进入驻地协调员、UNDAC与人道团队；世界粮食计划署原本满载救援物资飞入、空载返航，于是团队协助建设停机坪、制定装载流程并培训当地人员。10月9日起，直升机把约8000公斤蔬菜从Gre运到Nuwakot的Bidur。方案利用既有返程运力减少浪费，但多达700吨收成仍在等待，长期恢复仍依赖Syaphrubesi Bailey桥重建。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 灾后物流的好设计，是让已经在飞的资源同时解决第二个被忽视的问题。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 8000公斤是及时起点，不是替代道路重建的长期方案。

en-US.headlineFact: Nepal used relief helicopters' return legs to move 8,000 kilograms of harvest
en-US.headlineView: After floods destroyed the only road, the UN turned empty return capacity into a vegetable-market link, but as much as 700 tons still waits
en-US.headlineFull: Nepal used relief helicopters' return legs to move 8,000 kilograms of harvest; After floods destroyed the only road, the UN turned empty return capacity into a vegetable-market link, but as much as 700 tons still waits
en-US.intro: After the August 26 Bhotekoshi flood destroyed bridges and roads in Rasuwa, Nepal, about Rs 80 million of cabbage and potatoes across four wards of Aamachhodingmo was cut off from markets. A request sent to the UN Nepal Facebook page reached the Resident Coordinator, UNDAC and humanitarian teams. World Food Programme helicopters were already flying relief in and returning empty, so teams helped build a helipad, set loading procedures and train local people. Starting October 9, helicopters moved about 8,000 kilograms of vegetables from Gre to Bidur in Nuwakot. The design used existing return capacity to reduce waste, but as much as 700 tons still awaits transport and lasting recovery depends on rebuilding the Bailey bridge at Syaphrubesi.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Good disaster logistics lets resources already moving solve a second overlooked problem.
en-US.doudouQuote: Eight thousand kilograms is a timely start, not a substitute for rebuilding the road link.

sources.title: A Harvest, an Inbox and a Helicopter

zh-CN.headlineFact: 海洋增暖正在强化海上大气波导
zh-CN.headlineView: 1940至2025年数据表明，中低纬海域的波导出现概率、强度和顶高持续上升，影响雷达、通信与导航
zh-CN.headlineFull: 海洋增暖正在强化海上大气波导；1940至2025年数据表明，中低纬海域的波导出现概率、强度和顶高持续上升，影响雷达、通信与导航
zh-CN.intro: 《自然·气候变化》研究使用1940至2025年ERA5再分析数据，发现全球中低纬海洋上空的大气波导出现概率、强度和顶高呈稳健上升趋势。大气波导由折射率异常梯度形成，会像天然波导一样把电磁能量困在特定高度：它既能延长超视距传播，也会制造盲区、杂波和与标准模型不符的传播距离。机制上，海洋边界层持续增暖并加强低层静力稳定度，是长期变化主因；厄尔尼诺等年际模式会调制异常，但不足以解释长期趋势。结论对船舶通信、雷达、导航和海上安全有直接意义，具体系统影响仍需结合区域气象与设备频段评估。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 气候变化也在改写电磁传播环境，基础设施模型不能只更新硬件而不更新大气。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 趋势是全球性的，实际盲区仍要按海域、天气和频段具体评估。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与科技。

en-US.headlineFact: Ocean warming is strengthening maritime atmospheric ducts
en-US.headlineView: Data from 1940 to 2025 show rising duct probability, strength and top height at mid and low latitudes, affecting radar, communication and navigation
en-US.headlineFull: Ocean warming is strengthening maritime atmospheric ducts; Data from 1940 to 2025 show rising duct probability, strength and top height at mid and low latitudes, affecting radar, communication and navigation
en-US.intro: A Nature Climate Change study used ERA5 reanalysis from 1940 to 2025 and found robust increases in atmospheric-duct occurrence probability, strength and top height over mid- and low-latitude oceans. Atmospheric ducts form from unusual refractivity gradients and trap electromagnetic energy within certain layers. They can extend beyond-line-of-sight propagation but also create blind zones, clutter and ranges that standard models do not predict. The sustained warming and increased static stability of the marine boundary layer explain the long-term shift; interannual modes such as El Niño modulate anomalies but do not dominate the trend. The result matters directly for ship communication, radar, navigation and maritime safety, while system-level impact still depends on regional weather and equipment frequency.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Climate change is rewriting electromagnetic propagation, so infrastructure models must update the atmosphere as well as hardware.
en-US.doudouQuote: The trend is global; actual blind zones still depend on sea area, weather and frequency.

sources.title: Warming-driven lower-tropospheric stratification intensifies ducting over global oceans

zh-CN.headlineFact: 14国仅15%受访者知道酒精可致乳腺癌
zh-CN.headlineView: WHO欧洲区上线证据受限的AI助手，帮助医务人员用AUDIT十问筛查并开展简短干预
zh-CN.headlineFull: 14国仅15%受访者知道酒精可致乳腺癌；WHO欧洲区上线证据受限的AI助手，帮助医务人员用AUDIT十问筛查并开展简短干预
zh-CN.intro: WHO欧洲区在14个国家的调查显示，仅15%的受访者知道酒精可导致乳腺癌，女性知晓率也只有21%；2020年酒精在WHO欧洲区域估计导致39200例新发乳腺癌。WHO因此上线酒精筛查与简短干预中心，把AUDIT十问、标准饮酒量工具、实施资源与AI助手放在一起。助手只从限定的WHO证据和实施资料中回答，显示来源，并帮助医生、护士选择提问方式或咨询工具。平台降低了时间、培训和沟通尴尬门槛，但不能替代临床判断；筛查覆盖率、患者接受度、饮酒减少和癌症结局仍需长期评估。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 健康AI最有价值的地方，是把可信证据变成专业人员当场能用的下一句话。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 工具能帮助开口，风险沟通、诊断和治疗仍由专业人员负责。

en-US.headlineFact: Only 15% across 14 countries knew alcohol can cause breast cancer
en-US.headlineView: WHO Europe launched an evidence-bounded AI assistant to help health workers use the 10-question AUDIT screen and brief intervention
en-US.headlineFull: Only 15% across 14 countries knew alcohol can cause breast cancer; WHO Europe launched an evidence-bounded AI assistant to help health workers use the 10-question AUDIT screen and brief intervention
en-US.intro: A WHO Europe survey across 14 countries found only 15% of respondents knew alcohol can cause breast cancer, with awareness among women at 21%. Alcohol was estimated to cause 39,200 new breast-cancer cases in the WHO European Region in 2020. WHO launched an Alcohol Screening and Brief Interventions Hub combining the 10-question AUDIT test, standard-drink tools, implementation resources and an AI assistant. The assistant answers only from a defined set of WHO evidence and implementation material, shows sources and helps doctors or nurses choose questions and consultation tools. The hub reduces barriers of time, training and awkward communication but does not replace clinical judgment; screening coverage, patient acceptance, reduced drinking and cancer outcomes still require long-term evaluation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Health AI is most useful when it turns trusted evidence into the next sentence a professional can use in the room.
en-US.doudouQuote: The tool helps start the conversation; professionals remain responsible for risk communication, diagnosis and care.

sources.title: Alcohol can cause breast cancer, but very few patients get asked about their drinking
sources.publisher: World Health Organization Regional Office for Europe
